name: @ohmail/desktop
description: ohmail for Windows and Linux — a Tauri v2 shell around the ohmail client UI, fixtures-only, zero network.
//: Ranges, not exact pins, and the same ones the rest of the monorepo uses: an exact pin here puts a SECOND copy of @types/react in the workspace, and two React type identities break apps/webapp's typecheck. In the published mirror npm resolves these fresh; every CI run prints what it got.
//deps: The four below are not used by anything under apps/desktop/src — they are imported by the shared client sources this project compiles (the rich text editor in the compose and reply surfaces, and the mail renderer's HTML sanitizer). They are declared here because this manifest is the only one published with those sources: without them the mirror's `tsc --noEmit` and `vite build` both fail on modules npm was never asked to install.
